amendment.change: Removed only the direct uf_merton_dd.is_not_null() filter condition. The filter now checks its raw PIT inputs (pb, debt ratio, volatility and other existing quality fields); materialize_scoring_columns computes the custom factor in the scoring stage.
amendment.reason: R351 attempt1 failed before any returns because the Python filter directly referenced the not-yet-materialized uf_merton_dd scoring column.

classification: single-factor substitution in the C sleeve of the R344 extended-window portfolio; structural credit-risk proxy
diagnostics: Report the 2022 partial return and drawdown versus R344 control
Report 5x top1/top3/top5 net contribution versus R344 control
Report C standalone return and drawdown as diagnostic only; portfolio gates remain authoritative
Report factor contribution and holdings overlap with the control C sleeve
discipline: One factor substitution only; no parameter scan of the Merton formula or structural assumptions
No paper target or order file
Use historical membership, T+1 open execution and the system StrategyBacktestService
The zero-drift one-year Merton proxy is frozen before returns; do not tune the horizon, drift or volatility proxy after results
disclosure: The factor and strategy files were written before any portfolio return, drawdown, trade or concentration result was computed. The coverage-only preflight inspected factor coverage and cross-sectional correlations only. The 2022-05-05 start is inherited from R344 earliest common C-sleeve window. This is a quasi-out-of-sample temporal extension, not an independent 2018-2026 sample.
economic_rationale: The factor maps PIT PB and book leverage into a market-equity/book-debt ratio q, treats asset volatility as equity volatility times q/(1+q), and computes a zero-drift one-year structural distance-to-default proxy. It is not the previous book-solvency/vol ratio: candidate-only mean daily Spearman correlation with uf_solvency_buffer is 0.4779 and with the old low-vol leg is 0.4862; maximum mean absolute correlation with any retained scoring leg is 0.4862.

hypothesis: Replacing the C sleeve generic 15% low-volatility leg with an industry-neutral 15% Merton distance-to-default proxy improves the 2022 weak-market tail and net-of-5x-cost breadth without materially degrading long-window return or drawdown.
known_limitations: The zero-drift one-year proxy is not a full KMV/Merton calibration and does not use a term structure of debt.
PB and debt ratio are PIT financial fields but market equity is inferred through PB rather than a full historical market-value balance sheet.
Financial firms are handled by within-industry neutralization rather than a separate credit model.
Current-snapshot industry classification is backfilled through history.
Membership is reconstructed and ETF qfq is not official PIT total return.
The common window starts in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier.
The 10% C cap, broad C design and gold trend rule were selected in prior post-hoc research.

reference_control.use: fixed comparison construction; R344 remains a failed/no-candidate result and is not relabelled

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record the result as research-only negative evidence and do not promote or generate paper targets. No threshold, weight, cap or window changes after results.

added_component.neutralization: industry_l1 demean plus within-industry z-score; all other scoring legs are excluded from neutralization
added_component.structural_assumptions: one-year horizon, zero asset drift, debt point equal to book liabilities, asset volatility approximated from 20-day equity realized volatility and market leverage

single_mutation.control: R344 extended-window construction with C = ai_hs300_quality_momentum_broad_h60
unchanged: monthly A/B/C inverse-volatility risk parity with [0.20, 0.60] bounds
gold 200-day trend proxy and equal-weight defensive bucket
